Name: SassySquatch's Medieval Bobbers
Author: SassySquatch27
Description:
Ole Timey Bobbers for a Rustic or Medieval playthrough.

Wanted something to match all of Gwen's Medieval Stardew stuff so I'm slowly going to add things in a Rustic/Medieval style using my own art and Asprite. I will take requests! I do work full-time at a hospital so I won't be super fast on uploads, they will take time!

I'm new to making mods, so any help is appreciated! Sorry in advance if there is any errors!

Hope to see other Rustic/Medieval players enjoy my mods! :)

Downloads.Description:
Make sure to have all requirements downloaded
